Plötzlich rasen turboaufgeladene Allrad-Renngeschosse mit bis zu 500 PS über die internationalen Pisten. Von den Fahrern kaum noch beherrschbar üben die Fahrzeuge mit ihrem Sound und ihrer unbändigen Kraft eine riesige Faszination aus. Erst schwerste Unfälle mit toten Fahrern und Fans machen der absoluten Unvernunft ein Ende. Heute genießen diese Autos Kultstatus und sind teuer bezahlte Sammlerobjekte. Ebenfalls legendär: Der BMW M E30 in der DTM-Version. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: SFT Wake Foil E-Foil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025

programme.title: Oman Downwinder Eng
programme.desc: The Oman Downwinder movie intents to show Oman and its conditions for wind powered sports. The movie was designed to explore the experience of professional kiteboarders\/wingfoilers (Ambassadors) interacting with amateur riders based in Oman on this 7-day trip along the coast. Apart from the Ambassadors, the movie also explores the Oman Kitesurfing community via local actors and their experiences during the downwinder.

programme.title: One Water Race 2025 - The Film Eng
programme.desc: One Water Race is an endurance race based on Running, Swimming and Orienteering. 10 mixed teams of 4 athletes have to cross the Stockholm-Sweden archipelago from North to South in a non-stop 250 km race with 200 km of running and 50 km of swimming. They have to completely handle their navigation including in the darkness.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Cape Verde 2026

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai or The Great Ocean in Maori, is about the FreeSwim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she swims 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline over three days to raise awareness for the protection of New Zealands oceans.
